paragraphs: (Rabbi) Abba the priest. He said to Rabbi Yose the priest, “I wonder whether Rabbi Yochanan accepted Resh Lakish’s answer” (Rosh Hashanah 15b). In the name of Rabbi Yose the priest: the incident in which the sons of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina died (and he bathed in cold water throughout the seven days; Ta'anit 13a). They were in Rabbi Yochanan’s time. (Perhaps Rabbi Chiyya and Rav Shemen were his sons.)
